articles.title: XRP Notches Best Week Since 2024 Election Pump on Bitcoin Short Squeeze
articles.snippet: The token's steepest daily and weekly gains in months rode Bitcoin's record liquidation wave—though ETF flows and futures data hint the move is running on borrowed momentum.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Sharpest Rally in Five Months Flips Markets From Bearish to Coin Flip
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's steepest daily gain since March caught traders off guard, and Myriad's pump-or-dump market swung from 70-30 odds to nearly even in a single day.

articles.title: Markets Confident OpenAI Releases Its Next AI Model in Weeks
articles.snippet: Traders are betting OpenAI's next frontier model lands within weeks—even after the company pumped the brakes.
